Internal helper: one filter condition, in words

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_table_filter_words.Rd

A comparison of a variable with a value is written with the variable's label and the mathematical sign – "Age (years) >= 30", the sign the character itself – and a code compared by ==, != or %in% as its value label ("Current smoker = No", "Region of residence = North or East"); & and | are "and" and "or", with parentheses where the two mix. A condition it cannot put into words – a function of a variable, a workspace object, a name that is not a variable of the data – is written as typed.

Usage

.jst_table_filter_words(cond, data = NULL, minus = "true")

Arguments

cond

Character(1); the condition as the result stores it.

data

The data frame it was applied to, for the labels; NULL writes the condition as typed.

minus

The style's minus setting, for a negative value.

Value

A list: text, and or (logical: the condition's top level is an or, which takes parentheses beside another condition).
